title: The Mughal Siege Around Banda Singh

blocks.text: Imperial messages continue under the seal of parvano shah, even as Banda boasts and tries to hold the camp together with words that no longer carry full confidence.
At the same time the narrative starts listing the deeper causes of his fall: the Guru Mother’s anger, lost discipline, and the fading of earlier gifts.
Parvano shah anchors the page because imperial paperwork and assurance now help do what open battle has not yet done.
